Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026   Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.  Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page   About the Role   Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution.  The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate.  What You’ll Be Responsible For    Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.  Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.  Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time.  Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits.  Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence.  Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement.  Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization.  Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   Must-have    +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management.  Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections.  Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).  Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language.  Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions.  A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer.  Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators.    Nice-to-have    Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks.  Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak.  Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure.  Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments.  Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies.  Chance of earning equity at Nubank  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance  Medical Plan  NuLanguage – Language Course Program  Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: IP Network Team Lead - São Paulo Based
description:
Nova vaga disponível para IP Network Team Lead - São Paulo Based em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

1GLOBAL  is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in‑house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL  operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.  We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital‑first businesses, including neo‑banks, global fast‑moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL  connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.  About the Team  We are looking for a talented and driven IP Networks Team Lead to join our Technology Department. Your mission is to deliver a world‑class network foundation supporting global mobile, cloud, and connectivity services.  As the IP Networks Team Lead, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and evolving our global IP backbone and data center networks, ensuring they are scalable, secure, and highly available. This role blends technical leadership and hands‑on engineering, guiding the team in building and maintaining next‑generation network infrastructure across our on‑prem and cloud environments.  You will act as both a technical authority and people leader, responsible for defining network architecture standards, enforcing best practices, and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.  We are open to hiring this role in São Paulo, Brazil. Fluency in English is essential for this role.  About the Role   Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network engineers, managing performance, priorities, and technical direction  Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, data center, and backbone network infrastructure  Architect and operate high‑availability global IP networks interconnecting data centers and cloud regions  Ensure network redundancy and resilience testing across service, infrastructure, and transport layers  Plan and oversee SDN and SD‑WAN to enable automation and dynamic traffic engineering  Deploy and manage routers, switches, and firewalls  Implement and maintain IPv6, QoS, and traffic‑engineering policies to guarantee consistent network performance  Monitor network health, performance, and capacity, ensuring high availability, low latency, and reliability  Investigate complex network incidents, lead root‑cause analysis, and ensure follow‑up actions are implemented  Ensure network security and compliance with internal policies and industry standards (ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS, CIS)  Automate network provisioning, configuration, and monitoring using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools  Continuously improve observability and visibility using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and SNMP‑based systems  Support migrations, upgrades, and expansions while minimizing downtime and risk  Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, topology diagrams, and operational procedures  Generate regular network performance and incident reports with actionable recommendations    About You  Must Have   Experience:  10+ years as an IP/Networking Engineer, with expertise in designing, deploying, and managing high‑availability, scalable intercontinental networks (including at least 2+ years in a leadership role)  Mobile IP Networks & Backhaul:  Extensive experience designing and managing IP‑based mobile backhaul networks for 4G/5G, ensuring seamless delivery of traffic, data, and voice services  SD‑WAN & SDN:  Proven expertise with SD‑WAN and SDN technologies like Cisco ACI or NDFC, enabling network automation and optimization of global IP backbones  IPv6 & QoS:  Strong experience with IPv6 deployment and QoS configuration to optimize bandwidth and ensure high‑performance, reliable connectivity  Data Center & Backbone Design:  Skilled in designing and managing global IP backbones and interconnected data centers for high-performance, low‑latency connections  Advanced Network Protocols:  Expert‑level knowledge in TCP/IP stack, including TCP, UDP, ICMP, SMTP, SNMP, LDAP, DNS, NTP, and other essential protocols. Proficient in dynamic routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and MPLS  Network Security & Compliance:  Expertise in IPSec VPNs, security hardening, and compliance frameworks (PCI‑DSS, ISO 27001, CIS)  Layer 2 & Layer 3 Management:  Hands‑on experience managing Layer 2 (STP, MSTP) and Layer 3 multiservice networks with MPLS and traffic engineering  Network Automation & IaC:  Proficient in Terraform, Ansible, and other tools to automate network provisioning and streamline deployments  Network Monitoring & Observability:  Expertise in tools like Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP, and Wireshark for network monitoring and performance optimization  High‑Performance Networking:  Proven ability to design and optimize solutions for WAN optimization, traffic engineering, and latency reduction  Leadership & Collaboration:  Strong leadership skills in mentoring engineers, driving network strategy, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams    Nice to Have   Knowledge of Python for network automation, data collection, or tooling development  Hands‑on experience with redundancy validation, chaos testing, or network failover simulation  Familiarity with multi‑cloud networking and hybrid‑connectivity architectures  Experience integrating network telemetry into performance and reliability dashboards  Experience collaborating with global carriers, IXPs, and data center providers    Benefits   CLT contract  – enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work  Quarterly performance bonuses  to reward your hard work and achievements  Meal allowance paid into Caju card  – R$100 per working day  Extended parental leave  – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave  Health insurance with SulAmérica  – 50% covered by the company  Daycare allowance  provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child    Why 1GLOBAL?   Growth Opportunities:  Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs  Major Transaction Exposure:  Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry  Work with a Talented Team:  From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals  Dynamic Work Environment:  Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts  Professional Development:  Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field  International Experience:  Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company  Open Communication Culture:  Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment  Get Things Done Attitude:  Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry    1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Netwrok Engineer (Automation)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Netwrok Engineer (Automation) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Summary  The Automation Engineer (L3) is responsible for designing, developing, and operating network automation workflows using iTential as the core platform. This role integrates automation with ServiceNow for ITSM-driven execution (incidents/changes/requests) and establishes a robust CI/CD and version‑control practice using Bitbucket. The engineer partners with network operations and engineering teams to identify high-value use cases, build reusable automation modules, and improve reliability, compliance, and speed of execution across the network estate.  Key Responsibilities   Design and develop automation workflows on iTential for network operations, incident response, and change execution.  Integrate iTential workflows with ServiceNow to enable ticket‑driven automation (e.g., automated change creation/updates, approvals routing, execution status updates, closure evidence).  Build and maintain reusable automation components (templates, modules, libraries) to accelerate delivery and improve standardization.  Establish and operate code versioning, branching, peer‑review, and release practices using Bitbucket (pull requests, code reviews, release tagging).  Implement automation quality gates: unit testing, pre/post validation, rollback logic, and audit artifacts for compliance.  Troubleshoot workflow failures and platform issues; provide L3 escalation support and root‑cause analysis for automation incidents.  Work with network SMEs to translate operational procedures (runbooks/ROC) into safe, automated workflows and policies.  Develop and maintain dashboards/metrics for automation adoption, success rate, failure trends, and business value outcomes.  Support secure automation practices (least privilege, secrets handling, credential rotation where applicable) and alignment to customer controls.  Mentor L2 engineers/analysts, and contribute to automation playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base documentation.    Tools & Platforms (Experience With)   Advanced English  iTential – automation workflow development and orchestration (core platform).  ServiceNow – ITSM integration for Incident / Problem / Change / Request workflows and automation triggering.  Bitbucket – source control management, branching strategy, code reviews, and release management.  Network tool ecosystem (as applicable): Cisco SD‑WAN Manager (vManage), Cisco ISE, Cisco FMC/CDO, Meraki Dashboard, Arista CloudVision, F5 BIG‑IQ, InfoBlox Gridmaster, logging/telemetry tools.  Automation support tooling: API clients, REST/SOAP integrations, JSON/YAML, scripting utilities.    Required Skills & Experience   8+ years of network engineering / network operations experience with strong troubleshooting background.  Hands‑on experience building automation workflows on iTential (or equivalent orchestration platform) and operating them in production.  Strong understanding of enterprise networking: routing & switching, WAN/SD‑WAN, wireless, security fundamentals, and load balancing concepts.  Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean code practices, debugging, structured logging, and error handling.  Experience integrating enterprise platforms via APIs (REST preferred) and handling authentication/authorization patterns.  Experience with version control and DevOps practices using Bitbucket (Git), including branching, PR reviews, and release tagging.  Experience with ITIL/ITSM processes and integrating automation into controlled change/incident workflows via ServiceNow.  Ability to work in a global delivery model and support rotational/on‑call needs when required.    Preferred Certifications   Cisco certifications (CCNP preferred; CCNA acceptable depending on experience).  Automation / DevOps / Cloud networking certifications are a plus.    Soft Skills   Strong communication and stakeholder management; ability to explain automation outcomes and risks clearly.  Ownership mindset with strong prioritization and ability to operate under pressure.  Continuous‑improvement orientation; proactive in identifying automation opportunities and operational efficiencies.  Collaborative approach working across operations, engineering, and governance teams.     #J-18808-Ljbffr

Avaliar e acompanhar comunicados, alterações nos montantes de energia e atualizações das Regras de Comercialização da CCEE (Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica), realizando leitura crítica e análise de impactos para garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e a atualização dos processos internos. Garantir, validar e atualizar os dados e prazos relacionados à comercialização de energia e pagamentos das distribuidoras nos sistemas corporativos (SAP, WBC e outros), assegurando a integridade e consistência das informações operacionais.  Analisar e monitorar as atividades de pagamento de energia elétrica e encargos realizadas pelo CSC (Centro de Serviços Compartilhados), verificando relatórios e fornecendo suporte técnico para resolver divergências e manter atualizados os indicadores da área.  Garantir o envio correto das informações do balanço energético e dos pagamentos das distribuidoras para a ANEEL (Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica), preenchendo e validando dados nas plataformas SAMP e DUTO NET para cumprir as obrigações regulatórias.  Garantir a efetividade nos processos de fiscalização e auditorias internas e externas, organizando e fornecendo documentação técnica para assegurar a conformidade e transparência dos processos da área.  Realizar mensalmente provisão/projeção de valores para os contratos CCEAR por disponibilidade e demais custos relacionados com a compra de energia e encargos. Conheça um pouco sobre nós:  Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro. Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas. title: Staff Scientist for the EMA Beamline (Pesquisador Pleno - 428422)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Staff Scientist for the EMA Beamline (Pesquisador Pleno - 428422) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  To work in the Ema Group at the Brazilian Synchrotron Light Laboratory (LNLS).  The EMA beamline (Extreme Conditions Methods of Analysis) is dedicated to the study of materials under extreme conditions of pressure, temperature, and magnetic field, enabling access to regions of phase diagrams that are inaccessible through conventional methods. The beamline combines high-brightness X-ray beams with advanced focusing optics, enabling diffraction, spectroscopy, and coherent imaging experiments with high spatial resolution.  EMA integrates multiple X-ray techniques — including diffraction (XRD), absorption spectroscopy (XAS), and coherent imaging (ptychography and CDI) — combined with extreme environments such as pressures of hundreds of GPa, temperatures of thousands of Kelvin, and intense magnetic fields. The beamline supports in situ structural and electronic studies, with strong connection with materials science, geosciences, and condensed matter physics.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Provide high-level scientific support to users, contributing to the design, execution, and analysis of experiments;  Develop an independent and competitive research program leveraging the unique capabilities of the EMA beamline;  Lead the development and implementation of new experimental methods and instrumentation for studies under extreme conditions;  Contribute to the operation, commissioning, and continuous evolution of the beamline;  Supervise students and/or postdoctoral researchers;  Establish and strengthen national and international scientific collaborations.    Requisitos e qualificações   Ph.D. in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Mineralogy, Geosciences, or related fields;  Advanced English proficiency;  Experience with synchrotron X-ray techniques (such as XRD, XAS, XRS, CDI, or related methods);  Strong scientific track record and ability to conduct independent research;  Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.    Desirable   Experience with experiments under extreme conditions (high pressure, cryogenics, high temperatures, or magnetic fields). Role Description We are seeking an experienced Project Safety Advisor to support large‑scale, mission‑critical data center developments in Campinas, Brazil. This role will support environmental, health, and safety compliance activities throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring adherence to local legislation, project requirements, industry best practices, and established safety standards. The position requires close collaboration with project teams, general contractors, subcontractors, and key stakeholders to promote a strong safety culture and maintain a safe working environment in a fast‑paced, high‑impact construction setting. Review and maintain EHS documentation and evidence, including training records, competency verification, and site EHS plans. Track and report EHS performance, including KPI monitoring, findings, and corrective/preventive actions. Support incident and near‑miss reporting and investigations, ensuring action tracking and documentation. Participate in emergency preparedness planning and readiness verification. Complete assigned inspections, observations, assessments, audits, and other EHS‑related activities. Participate in meetings, training sessions, safety walks, and awareness activities. Provide training and onboarding support when requested. Monitor the implementation of project‑specific Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Plans and Construction Environmental Management Plans (CEMP). Actively identify opportunities, risks, hazards, and EHS requirements applicable to project facilities, processes, and personnel. Support compliance with applicable legislation, project requirements, and industry best practices. Collaborate with project teams and contractors to promote a proactive safety culture and continuous improvement in EHS performance.  Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. At least 4‑5 years of experience. Data center, mission‑critical, or large‑scale industrial construction experience is highly preferred and considered one of the most important qualifications for this role. Strong knowledge of construction safety regulations, EHS standards, hazard identification, risk assessments, and incident investigations. Experience conducting site inspections, audits, safety observations, and compliance reviews on active construction projects. Familiarity with High‑Risk Activities (HRAs), permits, lifting operations, working at heights, and other construction safety programs. Ability to manage EHS documentation, reporting, corrective actions, and stakeholder communications. Strong organizational, communication, and problem‑solving skills with the ability to work effectively in fast‑paced construction environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and EHS management/reporting systems. Professional‑level English proficiency (written and verbal).    #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing Manager em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.  With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.  We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.  The Role  CI&T is seeking a Marketing Operations & Performance Manager to lead the operational systems, processes, and reporting that support marketing for North America.  Based in Brazil, this role manages a marketing operations team responsible for marketing systems, campaign infrastructure, and performance reporting that enable demand generation campaigns, ABM initiatives, events, and digital programs to run efficiently.  You will work closely with marketing leadership, GTM managers, sales leaders, and cross-functional teams to ensure marketing programs are executed, tracked, and measured effectively.  This role focuses on strengthening marketing execution through scalable systems, clear lead management processes, and performance insights that support continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness and pipeline contribution.  Key Responsibilities  Leadership & Operational Coordination   Lead marketing operations supporting North America while managing, mentoring, and developing a Brazil-based marketing operations team.  Establish and manage marketing intake and operational workflows that prioritize requests and align teams on timelines, deliverables, and resources.  Coordinate operational support across campaigns, events, and GTM initiatives in partnership with marketing leadership and cross‑functional teams.    Sales & Funnel Governance   Partner with Sales leadership to ensure strong alignment between marketing and sales on lead lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, and funnel management.  Maintain governance over MQL, SAL, and opportunity definitions, ensuring clarity and consistency across teams.  Monitor funnel health and conversion performance, identifying areas where process improvements or campaign adjustments are needed.    Marketing Systems & Infrastructure   Identify opportunities to improve marketing systems, automation, and operational processes to increase efficiency and scalability.  Partner with internal technology teams, when needed, to implement system improvements that support marketing scalability.    Performance Data & Insights   Work with analysts to synthesize campaign and funnel data into strategic insights that guide marketing investment decisions.  Monitor website performance, search visibility, and engagement metrics, providing insights that support SEO, GEO, and AI‑driven search optimization (AEO) initiatives.  Identify trends in lead quality, engagement, and pipeline performance to inform improvements in targeting and campaign strategy.  Provide leadership with clear, actionable reporting that connects marketing activity to business outcomes.    Campaign Operations & Governance   Establish and maintain campaign operational standards, including performance measurement guidelines.  Ensure campaigns are structured to support audience targeting, lead capture, and funnel progression across marketing programs.    Process Optimization & Global Alignment   Identify bottlenecks across marketing processes and recommend improvements that increase speed, clarity, and cross‑team coordination.  Collaborate closely with CI&T’s global marketing operations team to ensure systems, processes, and reporting align with enterprise standards.    Qualifications  Required   6–8 years of experience in marketing operations within a B2B environment  Fluent or highly proficient in English, with the ability to work effectively with North America–based teams.  Experience managing marketing operations or campaign execution teams  Experience working with marketing automation, CRM, and intent platforms such as HubSpot, Pipedrive, 6sense, Demandbase, or similar tools  Experience supporting demand generation, ABM, or integrated marketing programs  Experience managing marketing data analytics, attribution models, and funnel reporting  Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously  Experience working in technology, consulting, or digital services environments  Experience supporting global marketing organizations with distributed teams, strongly preferred    Location  This role is based in Campinas or Sao Paulo, Brazil , working closely with marketing and sales teams across North America.  Benefits   Health and dental insurance  Meal and food allowance  Extended paternity leave  Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass  Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR)  Life insurance  Continuous learning platform (CI&T University)  Discount club  Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being  Pregnancy and responsible parenting course  Partnerships with online learning platforms    At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important to present your assessment during the selection process. See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here. This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. If you do not yet have the assessment, don’t worry: we can support you in obtaining it.  We have a dedicated Health and Well‑being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para UX/UI Designer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Toradex  is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.  About the Role  We are looking for a passionate and talented UI/UX Designer to help shape the future of our products and customer experiences.  This role is focused on understanding our users deeply and transforming those insights into intuitive, elegant, and impactful product experiences. The ideal candidate combines strong research skills, design thinking, visual design sensibilities, and a natural curiosity about how people interact with technology.  You will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and R&D teams to design experiences that help customers succeed while driving product adoption and business outcomes.  Our primary focus is on designing experiences for our SaaS IoT platform, Torizon Cloud ecosystem and related products.  User Discovery & Research   Develop a deep understanding of our target customers, their goals, workflows, motivations, and challenges.  Conduct user interviews, usability studies, surveys, and observational research.  Identify customer pain points, unmet needs, and opportunities for innovation.  Build empathy for users and become an internal advocate for customer needs.  Stay connected with customers throughout the product lifecycle to validate assumptions and gather feedback.    Product Design   Transform complex technical workflows into intuitive and user-friendly experiences.  Create user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.  Design experiences that balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.  Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to shape product strategy and roadmap decisions.  Define and refine interaction patterns, information architecture, and navigation structures.  Ensure consistency across products through the use of design systems and reusable components.    Cross-Functional Collaboration   Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and R&D teams throughout the product development lifecycle.  Communicate design rationale clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.  Participate in Agile planning, reviews, retrospectives, and product discovery activities.  Collaborate with engineers to ensure design quality during implementation.  Help foster a user-centered design culture across the organization.  Advocate for usability, accessibility, and design best practices.  Stay informed about emerging UX, UI, and product design trends.  Continuously improve design processes, methodologies, and standards.  Contribute to the evolution of the company’s design system and design maturity.  Raise the overall quality bar for design across the organization.  Leverage the UX as a driver for customer adoption of Torizon, further setting us apart from the competition.    We're Looking For Someone Who   Is self-motivated and driven to interact with, and understand the customer.  Is naturally curious and enjoys understanding how people think, work, and solve problems.  Is business driven and understands how the UX can be used to drive business objectives.  Has strong design instincts and can recognize the difference between something that merely works and something that feels effortless.  Is passionate about design and continuously seeks to improve their craft.  Enjoys solving complex problems and simplifying difficult workflows.  Demonstrates ownership and initiative without waiting to be directed.  Can confidently challenge assumptions and advocate for users.  Is comfortable working in highly technical product environments.  Thrives in collaborative, cross-functional teams.    Required Skills & Experience   Strong English communication skills, written and spoken.   Available to work Hybrid from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP.   Proven experience researching, designing, and delivering successful digital product experiences.  Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design thinking, problem solving, and measurable business impact.  Experience conducting user research and translating findings into actionable design recommendations.  Proficiency with Figma and modern product design workflows.  Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and interactive design concepts.  Experience using analytics and experimentation tools to evaluate design effectiveness.  Strong understanding of usability principles, interaction design, and information architecture.  Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.  Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.  Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  Ability to understand business objectives and translate them into meaningful user experiences.    Nice-to-Have Skills   Experience designing enterprise software, developer tools, engineering tools, or technical products.  Experience with SaaS platforms.  Experience with IoT , OTA update systems, edge computing, or cloud-based device management platforms.  Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems.  Front-end development experience, particularly with Vue.js and Quasar Framework.  Familiarity with Storybook and component-driven design workflows.  Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.    What we offer   An agile and inter-cultural work environment.  Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment.  Participation in defining processes and your working environment.  Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.  Opportunities for your personal development.  Meal allowance (flash card).  Health and dental care.  Parking space.  Anniversary day off.    Disclaimer: This is not a temporary role. It is a long-term, full-time opportunity.   Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.  We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Estamos presentes no Brasil desde 2015, com unidades em Campinas, São Paulo, Manaus e Camaçari.  Nós nos dedicamos à fabricação de painéis solares, baterias e chassis de ônibus elétricos e produção de automóveis híbridos plug-in e elétricos na nossa fábrica em Camaçari, na Bahia. Comercializamos também automóveis, caminhões e empilhadeiras elétricas, além de termos um projeto de Skyrail em São Paulo, onde forneceremos trens e sistemas para a Linha 17 – Ouro do Metrô de São Paulo. Atuar na concepção e construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em IA Generativa, agentes e multiagentes, aplicados ao domínio de Cadastro de Clientes, com foco em análise autônoma de dados, identificação de padrões, geração de recomendações e suporte à tomada de decisão.  O profissional será um dos responsáveis por transformar dados cadastrais em inteligência acionável, utilizando Analytics avançado, Machine Learning e LLMs, apoiando a evolução do Golden Record, da qualidade de dados e da governança do MDM em ambientes cloud. Liderança técnica, guiar e orientar engenheiros de dados, influenciando decisões críticas e elevando o nível técnico da organização.     Projetar e desenvolver agentes e multiagentes de IA capazes de:   Analisar dados cadastrais em larga escala.  Identificar padrões, inconsistências, gaps e anomalias.  Propor regras de negócio e ações corretivas de forma inteligente.  Gerar alertas e recomendações explicáveis.        Aplicar Analytics e Machine Learning para:   Detecção de anomalias e comportamentos suspeitos.  Scoring, clusterização e classificação de dados cadastrais.  Apoiar estratégias de qualificação, enriquecimento e priorização de dados.        Utilizar IA Generativa (GenAI) para:   Apoiar a geração, evolução e explicação de regras de negócio.  Construir mecanismos de recomendação baseados em dados (Agentes e Multi agentes).  Explorar arquiteturas como RAG, agentes autônomos e workflows inteligentes.        Trabalhar com dados e modelos em ambientes Cloud (Azure e GCP):   Uso intensivo de Databricks para análise e preparação de dados.  Uso de GCP e Gemini como apoio a soluções GenAI.      Atuar junto aos times de MDM, Dados, Tecnologia e Negócio, garantindo que a inteligência gerada seja mensurável, governável e aplicável.    Requisitos Técnicos   Experiência sólida como Cientista de Dados ou papel equivalente.  Forte conhecimento em Python para análise de dados, ML e IA.  SQL e exploração de dados estruturados.  Técnicas de Machine Learning aplicado (anomalias, classificação, clustering).     Vivência e experiência em IA Generativa (LLMs).  Arquiteturas de agentes e sistemas autônomos.  Experiência em ambientes Cloud, preferencialmente Azure Databricks/GCP (Gemini).  Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas e inteligentes.    Perfil Desejado   Proatividade e curiosidade analítica.  Interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias.  Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.  Foco em resultados e melhoria contínua.    Diferenciais   Experiência com dados críticos (clientes, identidade, cadastro, KYC).  Conhecimento de qualidade de dados e governança.  Experiência prática com multiagentes, automação cognitiva ou sistemas baseados em decisões autônomas.  Vivência em ambientes regulados.    Essência do papel  Não é um cientista de dados para “construir modelos isolados”. É um construtor de inteligência, que usa dados e IA para pensar, recomendar e agir sobre o Cadastro. Temos um time dedicado de Saúde e Bem-estar, especialistas em inclusão e grupos de afinidade que estarão com você em todas as etapas. Mentor team members when needed and contribute with meaningful reviews.    About You   5+ years experience in Java software development.  2+ years engineering leadership experience.  Good understanding of system architecture, cloud services (AWS), and scalable infrastructure.  Experience with unit/integration/e2e testing (test driven development is a plus).  Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming the interfaces.  Solid experience with relational databases, CI/CD flows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.  Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self‑motivated and autonomous mindset. Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day.  Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company.  Extended parental leave – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.  Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.  Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.  Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.  Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.  International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.  Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.  Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.    1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer. We value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. title: Senior Incident Specialist
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Incident Specialist em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.  In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.  We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.  About the role  The Senior Incident Specialist is accountable for the end-to-end management of major application incidents and crises affecting business-critical systems within the Application Management Services (AMS) portfolio. This role ensures rapid service restoration, clear communication, and strong governance during high-severity incidents, while driving continuous improvement of application reliability, operability, and resilience.  The position operates at the intersection of software engineering, application support, product teams, and business stakeholders, with a strong emphasis on application behavior, integrations, data flows, and code-level root causes, rather than infrastructure events.  What you’ll do  Major Incident & Crisis Management   Act as Major Incident Owner (MIO) for high-severity application incidents (Severity 1 & 2), coordinating all technical and business activities.  Lead application-focused incident bridges, ensuring correct prioritization of remediation activities across development, AMS, QA, vendors, and product teams.  Maintain full ownership from detection through service restoration and closure, including executive updates and formal incident closure.  Make risk-based decisions (rollback, feature disablement, workaround vs. permanent fix) in collaboration with application owners.    Application-Centric Incident Coordination   Application defects and regressions  Integration failures (APIs, middleware, third-party services)  Data inconsistencies, corruption, or processing failures  Performance degradation at the application or transaction level  Failed deployments, releases, or configuration changes  Ensure infrastructure findings are translated intoapplication-level impacts and actions, keeping focus on software behavior.    Crisis Communication & Stakeholder Management   Serve as the single point of accountability during crises for business stakeholders.  Provide clear, concise, and application-impact–focused communication to:  Senior leadership / executives  Business owners and product managers  Customer-facing teams (support, service desk)  Manage customer-impact messaging in partnership with business and communications teams.  Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews (PIRs) focused on application design, testing gaps, monitoring, and operational readiness.  Ensure root cause analysis (RCA) clearly addresses application logic, design decisions, and process failures—not only symptoms.  Track and enforce corrective and preventive actions, including:  Code fixes and refactoring  Monitoring and alerting improvements  Deployment and release process enhancements  Runbook and support model updates    Governance, Metrics & Readiness   Define and monitor incident KPIs related to application stability (MTTR, recurrence rate, failed changes, incident volume by app).  Ensure applications meet operational readiness standards before go-live (monitoring, supportability, rollback, documentation).  Contribute to resilience engineering efforts, including chaos testing, failover simulations, and crisis drills.    What you’ll need   Bachelor's degree completed in related fields.  Strong expertise inApplication Management Services (AMS) and production application support.  Deep understanding of, application architectures (monolith, microservices, event-driven), APIs and integrations, CI/CD pipelines and release management and application monitoring, logging, and observability tools  Excellent facilitation skills to manage multi-disciplinary technical teams during crises.  Executive-level communication skills, able to translate technical failures into business impact and recovery plans.  Strong conflict resolution and negotiation capabilities.  Experience in application support, software engineering, SRE, or technical service management.  Experience in a Major Incident Manager, Crisis Manager, or Incident Lead role with direct ownership of critical incidents.  Hands‑on experience supporting business-critical applications (ERP, CRM, e‑commerce, financial systems, customer platforms).  Advanced English.    Nice‑to‑Have   ITIL v4 (Incident Management, Problem Management) certification.  Experience working in DevOps, SRE, or Agile/Scaled Agile environments.  Familiarity with cloud‑native applications and SaaS platforms.  Background in continuous improvement, reliability engineering, or platform governance.    Success Factors in This Role   Reduced Mean Time to Restore (MTTR) for application incidents.  Fewer recurring incidents due to strong root cause elimination.  Improved confidence from business stakeholders during crises.  Strong collaboration and trust between AMS, development, and product teams.  You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.    What We Offer   Performance based bonus*  Attendance Bonus*  Casual office and dress code  Days off*  Health, dental, and life insurance  Discounts on Ambev products*  School materials assurance  Language and training platforms    Equal Opportunity & Affiantive Action  AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affiantive Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Confira a oportunidade para Pesquisador Adjunto (Afirmativa para Mulheres | Nanoespectroscopia de Terahertz - 385183) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga  Para atuar no grupo de Nano-espectroscopia de Infravermelho (IRN) do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS).  O Grupo de Nano-espectroscopia de Infravermelho (IRN) do Laboratório Nacional de Luz Síncrotron (LNLS/CNPEM) é responsável pela operação e desenvolvimento das linhas de luz IMBUIA e TATU no acelerador Sirius, instalações abertas à comunidade científica nacional e internacional. Nossa principal missão é oferecer suporte de excelência aos usuários, viabilizando experimentos de ponta em espectroscopia, microscopia e nanoespectroscopia utilizando radiação síncrotron.  A equipe é formada atualmente por quatro pesquisadores — três físicos e uma química — além de dois especialistas dedicados ao desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e manutenção da instrumentação científica das linhas. O grupo também contribui ativamente para a formação de recursos humanos altamente qualificados, contando atualmente com quatro doutorandos e dois mestrandos.  Paralelamente às atividades de atendimento aos usuários, o IRN conduz projetos de pesquisa financiados por agências de fomento e colabora em estudos científicos de diversas áreas do conhecimento. O grupo tem alcançado destaque internacional em nanofotônica de materiais bidimensionais e é atualmente o único grupo brasileiro a operar a técnica de microscopia óptica de campo próximo por espalhamento (s-SNOM).  Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, acolhedor e multidisciplinar, que combina excelência científica, inovação tecnológica e forte espírito de equipe. Buscamos profissionais motivados a atuar na fronteira do conhecimento e contribuir para o avanço de uma das mais modernas infraestruturas científicas do mundo.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Atender ao programa de usuários da linha TATU, atuando como contato local na realização de propostas externas e internas;  Atuar em atividades de treinamento, capacitação e divulgação para a comunidade de usuários do LNLS;  Desenvolver pesquisa interna própria ou em sintonia com pesquisas já em andamento no centro, especialmente aquelas em desenvolvimento na Divisão de Materiais Moles e Biológicos (DMB) do LNLS;  Desenvolver melhorias e pequenos projetos de instrumentação em óptica de terahertz voltados ao avanço dos experimentos para a comunidade de usuários;  Disponibilidade para eventual trabalho aos finais de semana e em horários noturnos.    Requisitos e qualificações   Doutorado completo em Física, Engenharia Física, Química, Ciência dos Materiais ou áreas correlatas;  Inglês fluente, com capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita em ambiente científico internacional;  Sólida experiência em microscopia de força atômica (AFM) aplicada à caracterização de materiais;  Experiência em técnicas de varredura por sonda local (Scanning Probe Microscopy – SPM), tais como AFM, SNOM, STM ou correlatas;  Experiência em montagem, alinhamento e operação de experimentos ópticos utilizando lasers de baixa potência;  Experiência em espectroscopia vibracional aplicada à investigação de materiais;  Experiência na operação, desenvolvimento ou manutenção de instrumentação científica complexa;  Experiência em análise quantitativa de dados espectroscópicos e microscópicos;  Experiência na condução de projetos científicos independentes demonstrada por publicações em periódicos internacionais;  Experiência em colaboração multidisciplinar envolvendo física, química, ciência dos materiais ou engenharia;  Experiência com ambientes de pesquisa em grandes instalações científicas (síncrotrons, lasers, microscópias avançadas, laboratórios nacionais ou centros multiusuários);  Conhecimento em espectroscopia de infravermelho (FTIR) convencional ou baseada em radiação síncrotron, nos modos transmissão, reflexão e ATR;  Conhecimento em fundamentos de interação radiação-matéria, incluindo fenômenos vibracionais, eletrônicos e ópticos em materiais;  Conhecimento em propriedades ópticas de materiais, incluindo constante dielétrica, absorção, reflexão, dispersão e polaritons;  Conhecimento em técnicas de microscopia e espectroscopia de campo próximo (s-SNOM, nano-FTIR ou técnicas correlatas);  Conhecimento em instrumentação científica para experimentos ópticos e espectroscópicos;  Conhecimento em análise e tratamento de dados científicos utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, Matlab, Mathematica ou similares;  Conhecimento em caracterização de materiais nanoestruturados e bidimensionais;  Conhecimento em óptica clássica e alinhamento de sistemas ópticos.    Desejável   Experiência em suporte a usuários e treinamento de estudantes e pesquisadores (desejável).  Experiência em nano-espectroscopia óptica de campo próximo (s-SNOM ou nano-FTIR).  Experiência em espectroscopia na faixa do infravermelho distante, terahertz ou micro-ondas.  Experiência com detectores, fontes e instrumentação para a região espectral THz.  Experiência em materiais quânticos, materiais bidimensionais, polaritons, plasmons ou excitações coletivas.  Experiência prévia em linhas de luz síncrotron ou outras grandes infraestruturas científicas.  Experiência em desenvolvimento de novos experimentos ou metodologias instrumentais. title: ANALISTA DE COMÉRCIO EXTERIOR SENIOR (34785)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para ANALISTA DE COMÉRCIO EXTERIOR SENIOR (34785) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Descrição da empresa  At Bosch, we shape the future through high-quality technological innovations and services that inspire enthusiasm and improve people’s lives. We make a solid promise to our associates: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire one another. Join us and experience the difference.  Descrição do emprego  The Senior Imported Material Planner  is responsible for ensuring the continuous and optimized supply of imported raw materials and components to support manufacturing schedules. This role focuses strictly on material requirements planning (MRP), inventory parameters optimization, and international pipeline management, without operational customs clearance execution. The analyst acts as a strategic link between global suppliers, logistics partners, procurement, and internal manufacturing teams.  Additionally, this position plays a critical financial and operational role by monitoring Total Logistics Costs (TLC) and driving inventory management metrics, such as Days Inventory Onhand (DIO) and Red Stock. The planner will lead the consolidation and presentation of Monthly Performance Results, manage Current Forecast (CF) and Business Planning (BP) cycles, and head strategic projects focused on freight optimization, inbound expenses control, and inventory reduction.  Key Responsibilities:    Material Requirements Planning (MRP): Analyze and manage the procurement and scheduling of imported materials based on manufacturing demand, ensuring zero line stoppages while avoiding excess stock.  Pipeline & Lead Time Management: Monitor the international supply chain pipeline (from supplier shipment to plant delivery), managing exceptions, transit time deviations, and critical parts tracking.  Financial & Metric Control: Closely monitor and analyze Total Logistics Costs (TLC) and key inventory indicators, specifically driving the optimization of Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO) and the elimination of Red Stock.  Planning & Reporting: Lead the review and execution of Monthly Performance Results. Drive the strategic planning for Current Forecast (CF) and Business Planning (BP) to ensure strict alignment with corporate financial targets.  Strategic Projects: Lead continuous improvement and optimization projects focused on freight consolidation, inbound logistics expenses reduction, and inventory lean initiatives.  Inventory Parameterization: Define and maintain optimum inventory parameters in the ERP (Safety Stock, Reorder Points, Lot Sizes) considering long international lead times and demand volatility.    Qualificações   Education: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields.  Languages: Fluent English is mandatory (reporting to corporate/global levels and daily contact with global suppliers).  Experience: Solid experience in Material Planning (MRP/PCP) of imported items within a fast-paced industrial or automotive manufacturing environment.  Skills: Strong analytical mindset with experience in financial forecasting (CF/BP), inventory controlling (DIO), and logistics cost management (TLC). Deep understanding of international logistics dynamics (transit times, container utilization).  Systems: Proficiency in SAP (modules MM/PP) or similar robust ERP systems, and advanced Excel.    Benefícios da Bosch   Programas de Bem-Estar e Saúde: avaliação preventiva anual, ambulatório dentro da localidade para atendimento durante o horário de trabalho, programa antitabagismo, programa de saúde mental, fisioterapia e curso de gestante.  Assistência médica e odontológica.  Política de reembolso para algumas condições especiais de saúde.  Subsídio para medicamentos através da Funcional Health.  Jornadas de trabalho flexível com política de home office (não aplicado para horistas).  Short Friday para administrativo e horista do turno normal (apenas em Campinas).  Participação nos lucros e resultados (PLR).  Política de expatriação internacional e de transferências nacionais.  Plano de previdência privada e empréstimos com taxas diferenciadas.  Seguro de vida.  Associação opcional ao Clube da Bosch dentro da planta com academia, piscinas, churrasqueiras, campos de futebol, sociedade, espaço para eventos, ginásio de esportes, quadras de areia, quadra de tênis, lanchonete e calendário anual de eventos.  Auxílio para mamães com creche na planta (verificar vagas disponíveis).  Licença maternidade e adoção estendida de 180 dias.  Licença paternidade e adoção de 20 dias.  Alimentação no local de trabalho e Vale Alimentação.  Ônibus fretado (ou Vale Transporte).  Estacionamento gratuito (para quem vem presencial).  Benefícios de fim de ano com Cesta de Natal e ave congelada.  Brinquedo para filhos menores de 12 anos.  Material escolar para colaboradores (até nível universitário) e filhos (até final do ensino médio).  Política de subsídios para cursos técnicos, pós-graduação, MBA, especializações e idiomas.  Treinamentos e capacitações através da nossa universidade corporativa.  Premiação por tempo de casa (a partir de 10 anos e a cada 5 anos).  Participação opcional em várias ações de voluntariado via Instituto Robert Bosch.  Descontos com parceiros do clube: locação de veículos, mensalidade em universidades, cursos de idioma, lojas e outros.    Na Bosch, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação, por isso, todas as vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência, em situação vulnerável e grupos minoritários.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Vaga 100% remota   Aqui a gente conecta o mundo  A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.  Trabalhar aqui é pertender a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar. Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.  Conheça em nosso site:   Qual a missão do Cargo?   Prestar suporte técnico aos nossos clientes, oferecendo soluções com empatia e proatividade, garantindo que eles tenham a melhor experiência possível ao utilizarem nossos produtos. Essa pessoa será responsável por investigar problemas técnicos, orientar usuários e colaborar com times internos para resolver desafios de complexidades variadas.   Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?    Realizar atendimentos via ticket e, ocasionalmente, por videochamada;  Responder dúvidas e problemas dos clientes, atendendo múltiplos chamados simultaneamente;  Registrar, categorizar e priorizar chamados seguindo os SLAs definidos. Realizar testes na plataforma para validação de dúvidas e problemas;  Escalar problemas mais complexos para outros níveis quando necessário;  Analisar e debugar códigos (com orientação para casos mais complexos);  Integração com várias áreas da empresa como consultoria, engenharia e customer success;  Acompanhar issues abertas com o time de engenharia e atualizar o cliente sobre as evoluções da tratativa;  Participar de reuniões e encontros da área e da empresa, mesmo que online;  Contribuir para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais e das metas da área;  Entender e manter-se atualizado sobre as funcionalidades mais recentes dos nossos produtos, suas dependências, a pilha de tecnologia subjacente e seu impacto operacional;  Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos (documentação de soluções, FAQs, etc.);  Ser parceiro dos nossos clientes, buscando entender suas necessidades e oferecer o melhor suporte possível.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?    Comunicação clara e assertiva (verbal e escrita);  Conhecimento dos conceitos e práticas sobre APIs utilizando padrões de design RestFul (Familiaridade com integrações entre sistemas é um bom começo);  Capacidade de gerir ferramentas e interpretar dados de entrada/saída para diagnóstico de comportamento de sistemas, como forma de identificar problemas;  Capacidade de priorizar e escalar efetivamente os problemas dos clientes, conforme necessário;  Noções básicas de lógica de programação;  Noções básicas em bancos de dados relacional e não relacional e estruturação de consultas simples;  Familiaridade com ferramentas de Testes Funcionais de APIs (Postman, cURL e SoapUI);  Formação completa ou em curso em áreas de tecnologia ou correlatas.    Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?    Experiência anterior em suporte técnico N1 e/ou N2;  Conhecimentos sobre documentação de APIs utilizando OpenAPI Specification (Swagger) e fluxos de negócio;  Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e incidentes (Zendesk, Jira, etc);  Conhecimento de linguagens de script (e.g., JavaScript, Python, etc);  Inglês e/ou Espanhol Intermediário     Aqui você vai encontrar:    Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.     Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong  como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.    Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)   Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!   Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)    *Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Integração e Event Driven    Domínio dos estilos e padrões de integração (Shared Database, File Transfer, Remote Procedure Invocation e Messaging);  Domínio dos Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIP);  Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;  Experiência com mensageria e processamento assíncrono. Cloud Native e Plataformas    Arquitetura baseada em containers e Kubernetes;  Conhecimento em observabilidade, métricas, logs e health checks;  Conhecimento em Service Mesh (preferencialmente Istio);  Ferramentas e metodologias modernas de desenvolvimento de software.    Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?   Mercado de Seguros, Open Insurance e Open Finance;  Arquitetura corporativa e governança de tecnologia;  Modelagem e implementação de frameworks de governança;  Elaboração de diagnósticos e avaliações de maturidade arquitetural;  Construção de roadmaps de modernização tecnológica;  Estratégias de FinOps e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;  Observabilidade utilizando ElasticSearch, Kibana e plataformas correlatas;  Soluções de mensageria como Kafka, RabbitMQ e SQS;  Estratégias de cache utilizando Redis;  GraphQL;  Implantação de pipelines e esteiras DevOps;  Arquiteturas resilientes e distribuídas em ambientes cloud;  Conhecimento em Azure, AWS ou GCP;  Desenvolvimento em Java, Node.js, Python ou .NET;  Arquiteturas regulatórias e plataformas de compartilhamento de dados. Vaga 100% remota  Aqui a gente conecta o mundo  A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.  Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar. Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.  Conheça + em nosso site:   Qual a missão do Cargo?  Garantir a excelência técnica das soluções desenvolvidas, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em arquiteturas de software robustas, escaláveis e sustentáveis. Atuar como referência técnica para o time, assegurando a aplicação de padrões, boas práticas e consistência arquitetural ao longo de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento. Também será responsável por evoluir continuamente a arquitetura, promovendo a maturidade técnica do time e contribuindo para a construção de soluções que sustentem o crescimento do negócio com segurança e performance.  Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?   Definir e evoluir padrões de arquitetura de software, garantindo consistência entre serviços e soluções desenvolvidas;  Atuar de forma hands‑on na construção de provas de conceito e validação de decisões técnicas críticas;  Apoiar tecnicamente o time no desenho e implementação de microsserviços, APIs e integrações;  Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, incluindo qualidade de código, testes automatizados e observabilidade;  Revisar e orientar decisões arquiteturais, assegurando aderência aos padrões definidos;  Apoiar a decomposição de sistemas e definição de domínios, utilizando conceitos como DDD;  Definir e orientar padrões de integração síncrona e assíncrona, incluindo mensageria e arquiteturas event‑driven;  Contribuir na definição de estratégias de escalabilidade, resiliência e tolerância a falhas;  Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura em ambientes distribuídos e cloud native; Identificar e tratar débitos técnicos, promovendo evolução contínua da base de código;  Atuar na mentoria técnica do time, elevando o nível de maturidade em engenharia de software;  Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de soluções e stakeholders para garantir a viabilidade técnica das propostas;  Disseminar boas práticas, padrões e novas abordagens técnicas no time.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?   Sólida experiência em arquitetura de software em ambientes distribuídos;  Forte experiência em desenvolvimento com Java ou Node.js;  Domínio de padrões de arquitetura (DDD, Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, etc.);  Experiência com arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e sistemas orientados a eventos;  Experiência com design e governança de APIs (REST, versionamento, contratos);  Experiência com mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka ou similares);  Conhecimento profundo em práticas de qualidade de código (testes automatizados, CI/CD, code review);  Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud;  Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e estratégias de persistência distribuída;  Domínio de padrões de integração resilientes (retries, DLQ, idempotência, circuit breaker, saga, etc.);  Capacidade de atuação hands‑on em cenários técnicos complexos.    Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?   Experiência com arquitetura em ambientes de alta escala e sistemas críticos;  Experiência com plataformas de integração e ecossistemas distribuídos;  Conhecimento em Azure, AWS ou GCP;  Experiência com práticas de observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing);  Experiência com aplicações multi‑tenant e modelos SaaS;  Conhecimento em arquitetura serverless;  Experiência com Apache Camel ou frameworks de integração;  Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e processamento assíncrono;  Conhecimento em Python;Experiência com arquiteturas modernas envolvendo streaming, eventos e integrações em tempo real;  Familiaridade com arquiteturas de agentes de IA e integração com LLMs.    Aqui você vai encontrar:   Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.    #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.  Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)  Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!  Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Coordenação de Produtos - BU Transacional - Campinas/SP  Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil  Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros. E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade.  Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi   Viver pelo cliente  Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.  Agir como empreendedor  Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.  Crescer na jornada  Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.  Modelo de trabalho  Presencial • Campinas/SP  Nosso time de Produtos  Responsável por desenhar e evoluir soluções que conectam as necessidades dos clientes com a estratégia do banco. Atua de ponta a ponta no ciclo de vida dos produtos, incluindo crédito, conta corrente, investimentos, meios de pagamento e canais. Combinando tecnologia, dados e visão de negócio, entrega jornadas completas, simples e seguras. É nessa diretoria que o presente se consolida e o futuro financeiro dos clientes ganha forma.   Liderar a estratégia e evolução dos produtos transacionais (Boletos, Convênios, TED e Serviços), garantindo crescimento acelerado e relevância no portfólio do banco;  Gerenciar equipe de profissionais, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico, autonomia e alta performance;  Conduzir metas agressivas de crescimento em usabilidade e volume dos produtos, com foco em experiência do cliente e resultados de negócio;  Revisar e otimizar jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos de fricção e oportunidades de simplificação;  Realizar benchmarking contínuo de mercado, identificando melhores práticas e tendências em meios de pagamento;  Gerenciar relacionamento estratégico com fornecedores e parceiros, negociando condições e garantindo qualidade na entrega;  Conduzir projetos de migração de fornecedores e implementação de novas soluções tecnológicas, se necessário;  Atuar de forma integrada com áreas de Tecnologia, UX, Fraudes, Compliance, Backoffice e demais stakeholders;  Monitorar indicadores-chave de performance (conversão, volume transacional, qualidade, NPS) e propor planos de ação baseados em dados;  Garantir sustentação operacional dos produtos, com gestão eficiente de incidentes e melhorias contínuas;  Conduzir fóruns executivos apresentando estratégia, resultados e tomadas de decisão do portfólio.
